text: Lily had a small red ball. She took it into the garden and threw it to her brother. The ball rolled under a bush. They looked together and found a sleepy cat beside it. Lily picked up the ball carefully so the cat could keep sleeping.

Tom wanted to bake a cake for his mother. He put flour and eggs in a bowl. His father helped him stir the mixture. When the cake was ready, they waited for it to cool. Mother smiled when she saw the cake on the table.

A little bird sat on the fence. It could see a bowl of water in the yard, but a dog was standing nearby. The dog walked back into the house. Then the bird flew down, took a drink, and returned to its nest.

Mia found an old box in the attic. Inside were pictures of her father when he was young. She carried the box downstairs. Her father told her stories about the pictures. They spent the rainy afternoon looking at them together.

Sam planted a bean beside the window. Every morning he checked the soil and gave it a little water. For several days nothing happened. Then a tiny green leaf appeared. Sam called his sister to come and see what had grown.

The bus stopped near the park. Ben and his grandmother got off and walked to the pond. They watched the ducks swim across the water. Ben wanted to touch one, but his grandmother said they should let the ducks stay wild.

Anna lost one of her blue shoes. She looked under her bed and behind the door. Her little brother pointed to a basket of toys. The shoe was inside the basket. Anna thanked him and put both shoes by the door.

A rabbit was looking for a quiet place to rest. It found a hole beneath a tree, but the hole was full of leaves. The rabbit pushed the leaves aside and curled up inside. Soon it was asleep, safe from the cold wind.
